variants.text: Nine hundred people in a cavern, lit by fungus and by what they can afford to burn, which is not much.
Lantern Deep. Terraces cut into the cavern wall forty feet up, and stairs everybody complains about.
The Great Lantern hangs over the whole town on a chain nobody can account for, unlit.
Warm, dry, and considerably more cheerful than it has any right to be.
